methodological_results_retained: C0/X6/X6C soundness logic conditional on the frozen field
proof-engine and extractor implementation equivalence results that do not depend on field-specific numeric rates
checkpoint_specific_numbers_not_transfer: projected runtime estimates that depend on decisive/UNKNOWN population
downstream_rebaseline_rule.required_after_new_checkpoint: Re-run the checkpoint-dependent diagnostic/certification population measurements before resuming X7.

v3_native_dense_objective_contract.requirement: The loss must backpropagate through SceneFirstSignedGeometryV3.signed-field queries themselves; V2 support-probability loss wiring is not accepted as V3 evidence.
v3_native_dense_objective_contract.foreground_semantics: For a camera ray, predicted foreground probability is a differentiable function of whether the V3 signed field enters the negative/interior side along the admitted ray segment.
v3_native_dense_objective_contract.recommended_surrogate: Sample the V3 signed field at a fixed preregistered depth lattice along each camera ray; compute a temperature-controlled soft minimum of signed values; map it through a sigmoid to ray foreground probability; apply boundary-weighted BCE plus soft Dice at source-raster resolution or a preregistered anti-aliased equivalent.

required_properties: dense loss reduces source-external silhouette support error
FORK_GAP and CONCAVE_NOTCH ground-truth geometry is not collapsed to the visual hull
thin and small components are not erased by the ray-depth soft-min surrogate
loss gradients remain finite and nonzero near foreground boundaries
opposite-view duplicate silhouette weighting cannot dominate the objective

orthographic_view_pair_semantics.note: For the sealed exact orthographic setup, opposite cameras provide the same projected occupancy support up to image-axis mirroring for closed opaque geometry; they are not eight independent silhouette constraints.
orthographic_view_pair_semantics.training_weight_rule: Normalize dense silhouette loss by independent opposite-view pair so a duplicated opposite projection does not receive double authority merely by enumeration.

evaluation: unchanged frozen Stage13-v2 on all eight views

knight_causal_arm_B_pair_holdout.purpose: Test whether dense raster-target alignment transfers to an unsupervised projection axis rather than succeeding only by direct target fitting.
knight_causal_arm_B_pair_holdout.still_available_as_forward_input: RGB/camera observations remain available because the question is dense-target transfer given the normal inference evidence.
knight_causal_arm_B_pair_holdout.important_nonclaim: This is not unseen-view or subject generalization: historical FIT geometry supervision can still constrain the field globally. It is specifically a dense-target leakage/collapse test.
knight_causal_arm_B_pair_holdout.primary_measurement: Stage13-v2 metrics on held-out pair [0,4] plus all-view diagnostics

hull_collapse_policy.source_external_support: Must decrease toward the calibrated source-support tolerance; unsupported outgrowth is never useful geometry.
hull_collapse_policy.knight_learned_hull_distance: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY__do not freeze a Knight-derived minimum-distance threshold.
hull_collapse_policy.alarm: A global trend toward learned surface == source visual hull is suspicious, but promotion-blocking thresholds must come from subject-free known-geometry fixtures.
hull_collapse_policy.hard_gate_owner: VF11 subject-free FORK_GAP/CONCAVE_NOTCH known-geometry preservation tests

checkpoint_provenance_gate.stage12_rule: Refuse zero-surface admission when checkpoint metadata does not prove the exact frozen V3 training producer/objective provenance expected by the preregistration.
